parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a lightweight and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the frame and rests on the ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, similar to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and stability, resting on the opposite ear to secure the glasses.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate, which holds the lenses and connects to the legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses and provides the structural integrity of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central connecting part for the two legs.
